implementation: Typed diagnostics reject unsafe archive receipt paths, provenance manifest paths, and archive members.
Archive receipts require one canonical non-symlink file component confined beneath the stage.

Provenance paths require canonical relative POSIX spelling, reject traversal, absolute paths, Windows/backslash ambiguity, redundant or dot components, symlink components, and resolved escapes while allowing legitimate nested files.
Tar extraction fully preflights every member, allows only confined regular files/directories, rejects links/devices/FIFO/socket/custom types and oversized regular members, then uses filter=data.
Valid final archive behavior and report semantics are preserved.

regressions.red: 15 intended failures before production remediation; no fixture/import errors
regressions.archive_receipt: absolute, parent, nested, backslash-ambiguous, and symlink cases rejected
regressions.provenance: absolute, parent, redundant/dot components, backslash, leaf symlink, and parent symlink cases rejected; canonical nested case accepted
regressions.tar_members: absolute/parent paths, FIFO, character device, block device, socket, symlink, hardlink, and oversized member cases rejected
regressions.preflight: safe member is not extracted before a later unsafe member is detected

verification.malformed_probe: PASS rejection with unsafe archive checksum path
verification.wrong_sha_probe: PASS rejection with archive SHA-256 mismatch
verification.oracle_review: PASS; no concrete security or Python 3.13 compatibility defect
